Name: Advanced Character Customization Menu
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
[youtube]nuK0-5ye3Bk[/youtube]

[size=5][u][b]Overview[/b][/u][/size]

This is a simple but useful mod that improves the experience of character customization by opening a scrollable menu with previews when choosing character customization parts.

To open the menu for a given customization part, click on the label or current number for skin, hair, shirt, pants, or accessory.

To exit the menu, press the back button or one of the game's menu buttons (e.g. Esc or E).

You can now rotate the previews with the arrow buttons below the menu.


[u][size=5][b]Technical[/b][/size][/u]

Requires SMAPI.

Implements a [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] interface to change config settings in-game.

Code is at [url=https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods]https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods[/url].

A list of all my mods for Stardew Valley is available at [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/895]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/895[/url].
